bound_need_one_field: Fill in at least one of Min / Max / Density
bounds_needs_numeric_bound: method=bounds requires at least one numeric bound; use the effective method for a density-only calibration
bound_must_be_finite: The {name} bound must be a finite number
max_bound_zero_scales_tree: A Max bound of 0 rescales every age in the tree to 0 (and divides the solver by zero); enter a positive maximum age
min_bound_exceeds_max_bound: The Min bound cannot be greater than the Max bound
node_id_not_in_tree: node_id {node_id} is not present in the current tree
node_id_is_tip: node_id {node_id} is a tip and cannot serve as a calibration target
calibration_has_no_target: The calibration has neither a node_id nor a taxon_set
taxon_set_unknown_names: Names in taxon_set are neither tips nor resolvable clades: {names}
taxon_set_empty_after_resolution: taxon_set resolved to an empty set (the clade contains no tips of the current tree)
taxon_set_single_tip: taxon_set {taxa} corresponds to a single tip, not an internal node
branch_var_missing_columns: {path} is missing the column(s) {columns}; a header with node_id and var is required
ddbd_no_internal_nodes: The tree has no internal nodes, so the ddBD density cannot be computed
